title: StackChoicePickRequest
description: STACK-MODELS-PAGE-01. The body of `PUT /stack/v1/choices/{category}/{tier}`: the model for a category and level (a candidate id, `recommended` to clear the pick, or `off` to switch a level off), optional customization, optional hardware profile, and whether to start the download.

model.description: A model id from the category's candidates, `recommended` (clear the pick), or `off` (switch the level off; not for Standard).

options.description: Customization stored with the pick, for example `{ "thinking": true }`.

profile.description: The hardware profile this assignment is for; omitted means this computer's own profile.

install.description: Start the download when the model is not installed (this computer's profile only). Default true.
